adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. But `refreshOAuthTokens` treats that argument as a Cal.com **userId** and sends it to the sync endpoint as `calcomUserId` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). This is inconsistent with other integrations in the diff, which pass `credential.userId`. If `credentialId` is the credential record ID (as the name suggests), the sync endpoint will be queried with the wrong identifier, leading to incorrect token retrieval and potentially updating the wrong credential.
